```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)
library(janitor)
library(scales)
library(readxl)

data <- read_csv(here::here("data/io.csv"))

postprotect <- data %>% 
  filter(postprotect) #06-24-04

postbooker <- data %>% 
  filter(postbooker) #dates are not right #12-10-2007

postgall <- data %>% 
  filter(postgall)

postreport <- data %>% 
  filter(postreport)

present <- data %>% 
  filter(present)

highlight_above_avg <- function(ft){
  ft %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `Black Male`>Overall, 
     j = ~ `Black Male`, 
     bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `Hispanic Male`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `Hispanic Male`, 
       bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `White Male`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `White Male`, 
       bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `Other Male`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `Other Male`, 
       bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `Black Female`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `Black Female`, 
       bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `Hispanic Female`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `Hispanic Female`, 
       bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `White Female`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `White Female`, 
       bg="#Fba894") %>% 
    bg(i = ~ `Other Female`>Overall, 
       j = ~ `Other Female`, 
       bg="#Fba894")
}
```


## Average Sentence, by Federal District and Period 

```{r}
dem_avg <- function(df){
  df %>% 
    group_by(fedNum) %>% 
    summarize(avg_sent = mean(SENSPLT0, na.rm=T))
}

list_periods <- list(postprotect, postbooker, postgall, postreport, present)

avg_sent_dem_tbl <- map(list_periods, dem_avg) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "Period") %>% 
  mutate(avg_sent = round(avg_sent),
         Period = recode(as.character(Period),
                         "1" = "Protect", "2" = "Booker", "3" = "Gall", "4" = "Post-Report", "5" = "Present")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Period, values_from = avg_sent) %>% 
  rename("Group" = fedNum)

avg_sent_dem_tbl %>% 
  flextable()


```

Because most of the data is labeled under present day, we will only be considering this time period for region breakdown. 


## Average Sentence by Demographic and Federal District
```{r}
present%>% 
  select(SENSPLT0, fedNum, racesex_clean) %>% 
  group_by(fedNum, racesex_clean) %>% 
  summarize(avg_sent = round(mean(SENSPLT0, na.rm = T))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = racesex_clean, values_from = avg_sent) %>% flextable()

```

## Average Sentence by Crime Type and Federal District 
```{r}
present%>% 
  select(SENSPLT0, fedNum, crime_type) %>% 
  group_by(fedNum, crime_type) %>% 
  summarize(avg_sent = round(mean(SENSPLT0, na.rm = T))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = crime_type, values_from = avg_sent) %>% flextable()

```



```{r}
present %>% 
  select(crime_type, racesex_clean, fedNum, SENSPLT0) %>% 
  group_by(crime_type, racesex_clean, fedNum) %>% 
  summarize(avg_sent = round(mean(SENSPLT0, na.rm = T))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = fedNum, values_from = avg_sent)
```
